    Typebite

    Eat snacks, level up, and win typing duels to eat everyone else.

    Play online with friends?

    Online games use a matchmaking service (PeerJS, USA). Your IP address is sent to it and to the other players of your game, and the other players see your name and look. We store nothing about you. You can change this at any time. Privacy details

    Friends: room and server options

    Everyone who opens the game sees who is playing and can join. To play in a private group use the same room name:

    Advanced: a dedicated server (start-server.bat) on your own network:

    Touch
    Bump into someone to start a typing duel

    Green ring with +2 next to a name: in a duel you would type 2 words fewer than them. Red with −2: 2 words more.

    Snacks give less and less as you level up, and you can be caught while eating. Win a duel and you get all of your opponent's levels. Both players start from the same phrase length: the more is at stake (high levels or a big level gap), the longer it is. The player with the lower level types a few words fewer. Run away and get caught, and your opponent gets a shorter one.

    Touch: drag anywhere to walk, Dash and Run buttons, tap an item to use it. Bump into someone and the keyboard pops up for the typing duel. iPhone fullscreen: Share → Add to Home Screen.

    Graphics

    The number is what your browser hands to the game. With monitors of different speeds, or Low Power Mode on a phone, it can be lower than your screen can do.

    Above your monitor's refresh rate the game draws extra frames you cannot see. That can lower input lag a little but needs much more power.
